name: UP B.Ed Joint Entrance Exam Mock - Practice Test 2
courseName: UP B.Ed Joint Entrance Exam Mock

questions.question: What is the full form of B.Ed?
questions.hint: B.Ed stands for Bachelor of Education.

questions.question: Which council is the regulatory body for teacher education in India?
questions.hint: National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) regulates teacher education.

questions.question: According to the Right to Education (RTE) Act, education is a fundamental right for children of age:
questions.hint: RTE Act 2009 provides free and compulsory education to all children aged 6 to 14 years.

questions.question: Who is known as the father of modern psychology?
questions.hint: Wilhelm Wundt established the first laboratory for experimental psychology, earning him this title.

questions.question: The primary aim of teaching is:
questions.hint: The main goal of teaching is to facilitate learning and cognitive development.

questions.question: Which method of teaching was developed by Maria Montessori?
questions.hint: Maria Montessori developed the child-centered Montessori method based on scientific observations.

questions.question: While writing on the blackboard in a classroom, which technique is considered best?
questions.hint: Good blackboard writing requires bold, neat, legibly spaced letters.

questions.question: The concept of "micro-teaching" originated at which international university?
questions.hint: Micro-teaching was developed by Dwight W. Allen and colleagues at Stanford University in 1961.

questions.question: A child-centric education system primarily focuses on which of the following?
options: Needs, interests, and abilities of child
questions.hint: Child-centered education adapts methods to student needs, learning styles, and background interests.

questions.question: What does "cognition" mean in psychological terms?
options: Process of acquiring knowledge and understanding
questions.hint: Cognition refers to mental action or process of acquiring knowledge through thought, experience, and senses.

questions.question: What is the definition of "learning" in educational psychology?
questions.hint: Learning is a relatively permanent change/modification of behavior resulting from practice or experience.

questions.question: Which is the primary agency of socialization for young children?
questions.hint: The family is the first and primary source of social values, behaviors, and language.

questions.question: Generally, "gifted" children possess an IQ score above what number?
questions.hint: An IQ of 130 or higher is standard to categorize a child as intellectually gifted.

questions.question: According to Bloom's Taxonomy, what are the three main domains of learning?
questions.hint: Benjamin Bloom categorized learning domains into Cognitive (head), Affective (heart), and Psychomotor (hands).

questions.question: The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 replaces which previous policy in India?
questions.hint: NEP 2020 replaced the National Policy on Education of 1986.
